title: Find Original Array of Prefix XOR
description: You are given an integer array `pref` of length `n`. Find and return the unique array `arr` of length `n` such that `pref[i] = arr[0] ^ arr[1] ^ ... ^ arr[i]` for every `0 <= i < n`.
hints: Since `pref[i] = pref[i - 1] ^ arr[i]`, XOR both sides with `pref[i - 1]`.
That gives `arr[0] = pref[0]` and `arr[i] = pref[i] ^ pref[i - 1]` for all `i >= 1`.

examples.explanation: A single-element prefix array equals the original array [13].
Zero prefix XORs mean every original element is 0.
